vv61:1.1: Mahantaṃ nāgaṃ abhiruyha sabbasetaṃ gajuttamaṃ vanā vanaṃ anupariyāsi nārīgaṇapurakkhato obhāsento disā sabbā osadhī viya tārakā.
vv61:3.1: So devaputto attamano Moggallānena pucchito pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi yassa kammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. || ||
vv61:4.1: Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūto upāsako cakkhumato ahosiṃ pāṇātipātā virato ahosiṃ loke adinnaṃ parivajjayissaṃ. || ||
vv61:5.1: Amajjapo na ca musā abhāṇiṃ sakena dārena ca tuṭṭho ahosiṃ annañ ca pānañ ca pasannacitto sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adāsiṃ.
